title: PT Clinic Session Pain Score Leaderboard
dataSources: MedBridge exercises (`medbridge:exercise`), PT clinic sessions (`pt:session`), Hinge Health sessions (`hingehealth:session`), rehab range-of-motion logs (`rehab:rom`), and pain diary entries (`pain:diary`).
app: MedBridge exercise completions, clinic PT session exports, Hinge Health digital sessions, ROM measurement logs, and pain diary entries forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=pt:session pain_score=*
| stats sum(pain_score) as total_value, avg(pain_score) as avg_value by therapist_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks therapist values by total and average pain score across PT clinic session events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `pain_score` values for each PT clinic session event and review total and average pain score by therapist.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total pain score.
grandmaExplanation: It flags which therapist shows the biggest pain score numbers in your PT clinic session data.
